a: FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) is a high school robotics program. Each January, FIRST announces a new game, and teams design and build a robot to play it. Team 1102 competes in FRC and welcomes students from grades 8 to 12.
Students in grades 8 to 12 from across the CSRA. You do not need to attend Aiken High School.

q: Do I need robotics or coding experience?
a: No. Most of what students learn, they learn on the team. There is work for every interest, from CAD and machining to code, video, and fundraising.

q: When and where does the team meet?
a: At Aiken High School. We meet year-round with short breaks. In the off-season, meetings are Tuesday and Thursday evenings.
Engineering (Design), Manufacturing, Programming, Media and PR, and Business.

q: Is there something for younger students?
a: Yes. We also run a FIRST LEGO League team that meets Thursdays and Saturdays.

q: How does the team keep families informed?
a: We use BAND for announcements, schedules, and reminders. Families get an invitation after a student joins.

q: How can my company support the team?
a: Visit the sponsors page for our giving levels, or email us. We can also use donated tools, materials, and mentor time.
